primary_endpoint: paired difference across group sizes: (HARP minus Joint regret at g=4) minus (HARP minus Joint regret at g=2), evaluated at rho=1
primary_prediction: the HARP-minus-Joint gap increases from g=2 to g=4
primary_confirmation_rule: paired mean > 0 and two-sided 95% Student-t confidence interval lower bound > 0
relative_effect_definition: 100 * (mean HARP oracle regret - mean Joint oracle regret) / mean HARP oracle regret
relative_effect_zero_denominator_policy: aggregate means are divided; no per-seed regret ratios are formed
